# pi-subagents 0.60.0 private integration

Source: npm pi-subagents@0.60.0, MIT license retained in LICENSE. Exact registry integrity is recorded in source-manifest.json lockTuple.

The227 factory/capability-ceiling source inputs were selected by the frozen M0 literal inventory and independently checked by esbuild (226 runtime inputs plus pi-runtime-compat.d.ts). Other package files are inactive. Both SDK host flavors consume this single source author. Upstream code is not represented as SDK-original.

The manifest records upstream and vendored SHA256 and per-file deltas. At baseline all229 original files (source, package metadata, license) are unchanged. Sealed refusal/backend changes will be individually recorded; fixed RPC Compile is outside this feature exclusion. Recursive runner/print dispatch remains disabled.

## SDK deltas

The source manifest enumerates every modified upstream file and SHA. The package entry `index.ts` loads the parent extension inside its async factory, not with a module top-level await. Pi awaits extension factories, and the `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD` skip is unchanged. This lets a single-pass CommonJS bundle include either host flavor. `resolveInstalledPiPackageRoot` in `src/runs/shared/pi-spawn.ts` finds the first `node_modules` package directory in its ancestor chain, as ESM resolution does, because a CommonJS bundle has no `import.meta.resolve`. The ordinary structured-output backend adds only a no-op feature-support seam. Existing effective-request admission sites call that seam before structured execution; the sealed build binds it to explicit refusal. The sealed backend preserves shape-only definition parsing but refuses execution, runtime creation, validation and recovery; it never returns an unchecked success. Retained-resume effective schema is checked before capacity acquisition. Refinement show/rollback remain unchanged.

The npm source package is an exact dev-only oracle for peer anchors and upstream comparison; both shipped host flavors consume only this vendored factory. Shipped external TypeBox remains client1.3.7; upstream declared1.1.38 is recorded separately, not substituted. Recursive dispatch, fixed RPC schema codegen and scripted workflow closure are outside this delta.
